    from collections import Counter
    print(label,"changes:",len(ch), Counter((x[2],x[3]) for x in ch))
    for x in ch[:20]: print("  ",x)
prev=current_frame.ascii
r1=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':20,'col':24}])
diff("after MOUSE Y")
prev=current_frame.ascii
r2=action(['UP'])
diff("after UP")
print("results:", r1.get('board_changed'), r2.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
